a1-arcade-dare-offer: Want a dare? Just for fun. Your stars stay the same.
a1-arcade-dare-earned: Dare done! Your dare marks are kept.
a1-arcade-dare-waiting: Your dare will wait for you. Try it any time!

a1-arcade-dare-4001: Free 8 fish. Clear lines through 8 fish, around the rocks.
